description: Dept. of Elections - Mr. Jayasinghe Bandara has been declared elected as a member of the Seventh Parliament for the Electoral District No. 18 - Polonnaruwa to fill the Vacancy Caused by reason of resignation of Mr. Pallewaththe Gamaralalage Maithripala Sirisena
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a parliamentary vacancy due to resignation, which falls under electoral processes. It involves the declaration of a new Member of Parliament to fill a vacancy in a specific electoral district (Polonnaruwa), following the procedures outlined in the Parliamentary Elections Act and the Constitution. This content directly relates to election results and declarations, making it clearly an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
